description: Push new events: we POST your endpoint when events of the kinds you chose land in the archives. Webhooks need a paid plan (Free has no webhook slots). `q` filters the ticker STATE; `event_q` filters the EVENT payload in the /v2/events grammar. Latency is the ingest cadence (analyst ≤1h, corporate kinds daily), not sub-minute.

channel.description: Delivery channel. `slack` is reserved and returns `501`.

device_id.description: Device to notify, from `POST /v2/devices/register`. Required when `channel` is `mobile_push`; unknown ids are a 404 `device_not_found`.

discord_url.description: Discord incoming-webhook URL. Required when `channel` is `discord`. Stored as a posting credential: the create response echoes it back under `channel_config`, but every later read (list, get, deliveries) strips it and sets `channel_config_present: true` instead.

event_q.description: Optional event-CONTENT filter in the `/v2/events` grammar — only `ticker`, `ts`, `kind`, `payload` may appear. Composes with `q`.

kinds.description: Event kinds to fire on — array or comma list.

q.description: Optional row-STATE filter evaluated against the event's ticker at fire time. Same grammar as scan `q`; custom signals are expanded and frozen at creation.

target_url.description: HTTPS delivery URL; or use `channel` + `discord_url`/`device_id`. Omit for in-app.

tickers.description: Scope to specific tickers (max 50). Mutually exclusive with `universe` — and with the singular alias `ticker` (sending both is a 400). Omit both for all tickers.

universe.description: Scope to a universe slug (`top_10`, `top_100`, or one of yours). `universe_id` accepted as an alias.

name: tickerbot_subscribe_events
